'''Law and crime'''
*[[Avijit Roy]], an American writer and blogger from Bangladesh, is hacked to death by unknown attackers in [[Dhaka]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/bangladesh/11438812/Atheist-US-blogger-hacked-to-death-in-Bangladesh.html (''The Telegraph'')]
*A gunman kills seven people then himself in [[2015 Tyrone shootings|a spree shooting]] in [[Tyrone, Missouri|Tyrone]], [[Missouri]]. [http://www.nbcnews.com/news/crime-courts/nine-dead-including-gunman-after-missouri-shooting-spree-police-n314071 (NBC News)]
*[[Assassination of Boris Nemtsov]]
**In Moscow, an unidentified attacker assassinates leading Russian opposition politician [[Boris Nemtsov]], the former [[Deputy Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation]] and current member of [[Regional parliaments of Russia|regional parliament]] of [[Yaroslavl Oblast]].
